theme: 3 terms on images: the view that shows one, how it fits, and Apple's built-in icons

terms.definition: A view that shows a single image on the screen.
terms.example: Show the avatar in an Image View with round corners.

terms.definition: A setting that decides how an image is scaled and placed inside its view.
terms.example: Use aspect fill as the Content Mode, so the photo has no gaps.

terms.definition: One of thousands of icons that Apple provides, which scale and match your text.
terms.example: Use an SF Symbol for the heart, no PNG needed.

quizzes.question: What do you call one of the thousands of built-in Apple icons that match your text?
What kind of view shows a single picture on the screen?
In this code, which setting decides how the image fits inside?

video.title: Image View, Content Mode & SF Symbol | Day 105
video.description:
Learn to explain how images fit in a view and where icons come from: Image View, Content Mode & SF Symbol, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Image View - A view that shows a single image on the screen.
Content Mode - A setting that decides how an image is scaled and placed inside its view.
SF Symbol - One of thousands of icons that Apple provides, which scale and match your text.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

Day 105 of the iOS Daily English series: 3 terms a day, from Swift basics to advanced iOS.

landscape.title: iOS Image View, Content Mode & SF Symbol | Day 105
landscape.description:
Explain Image View, Content Mode & SF Symbol in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
이미지 뷰, 콘텐츠 모드, SF 심볼 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Image View - A view that shows a single image on the screen.
한국어: 이미지 뷰: 이미지 하나를 화면에 보여 주는 뷰

Content Mode - A setting that decides how an image is scaled and placed inside its view.
한국어: 콘텐츠 모드: 이미지를 뷰 안에서 어떻게 확대·축소하고 배치할지 정하는 설정

SF Symbol - One of thousands of icons that Apple provides, which scale and match your text.
한국어: SF 심볼: 텍스트에 맞춰 크기가 조절되는, 애플이 제공하는 수천 개의 아이콘 중 하나

In this video, Mina and Jake fix a cropped icon and choose the right fit, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.
Mina와 Jake의 채팅 스타일 대화와 화면 속 Swift 코드로 배워요.

landscape.hook: Your icon looks cropped. Can you explain why in English?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, my star icon looks cropped in the Image View.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That fills the whole view and crops the edges. For an icon, use `.scaleAspectFit`.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Is the star an SF Symbol, then?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Does an SF Symbol scale with the text size?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, and it matches the font weight too. That's the big advantage.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: For photos, aspect fill works well in an Image View, with clipping on.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Good. Fit for icons, fill for photos.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Exactly. Pick the Content Mode for each case.
An Image View shows one picture, nothing more.
